_captured: Live from api.weather.gov on 2026-09-14 (01:13-01:20 UTC on the 15th) with curl and a contact User-Agent. Each member below is the response body it names, with only the long description/instruction prose shortened and parameters reduced to the keys the card reads; every field the adapter touches is verbatim.

active._source: GET https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active -> 200 application/geo+json, access-control-allow-origin: *, cache-control: public, max-age=5. 386 features nationally; 342 of them carried geometry: null and are reachable only through affectedZones/geocode, and all 386 carried web: "http://www.weather.gov" -- the agency home page, not a page about the alert. The two kept here are one of each geometry kind.

cancelled._source: CONSTRUCTED, not captured: no Cancel was in force at the probe. The value is the API's OWN enumeration -- GET /alerts/active?message_type=Bogus answered 400 with 'Does not have a value in the enumeration ["alert","update","cancel"]' -- and the feature is otherwise the captured zone-based Heat Advisory with its messageType switched to Cancel.

badRequest._source: GET https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?limit=50 -> 400 application/problem+json. The API rejects a query parameter it does not know rather than ignoring it, so a malformed ask is a failure state the card has to show, not an empty answer.
